plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)

contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.61.0 (devDependency: the release manifest contract)
features: the OpenVibe Frame: navbar, footer, panels, account switcher, notification UI with realtime
release manifest, in-place updates in open tabs and update metrics
page shell: openvibe-shared/shell page(), the shared page shell every web product renders through
shipped pill, recent list and /updates log
server helpers: ready, metrics, trace, egress, config, analytics, legal, SEO, frame SSR
browser harness and perf budgets for tests
a CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED notification type: an agent owner is told when a sensitive-capability confirmation awaits them
